title.rendered: Best Laser Hair Growth Devices: How Kiierr Stacks Up

content.rendered:
Hair loss is no joke, and unfortunately millions of men and women suffer from hair loss around the world every day. Alopecia affects nearly 50% of men over the age of 40 and 75% of women over the age of 65 according to this source. That’s an enormous amount of people!

To this day, there is no permanent cure, but there are devices on the market that can help you slow down your hair loss condition. With the impressive technological advances in the hair growth industry, scientists and medical professionals are leading the way to push past hair loss once and for all. One of the best laser hair growth treatment methods available today are laser devices.

The industries best laser hair growth devices for hair growth are a popular, effective, and powerful method that naturally stimulate hair growth.

Now we will compare different laser devices for hair growth available on the market today and show you how Kiierr stacks up. Read on to learn more!

The Best Laser Hair Growth Devices 

Before we dive deep into all laser device options available, we are going to discuss what qualities the best laser hair growth devices possess. Number one and the most important, the best laser hair growth devices are FDA-cleared. This means that the device has undergone testing and trials and is cleared by the Federal Drug Administration as being safe and effective for human use.

Another important quality is that the device is equipped with medical grade laser diodes instead of LEDs. Medical grade laser diodes can also be referred to as cold lasers. This is because these lights do not produce heat throughout treatment.

Note the number of lasers that are present in the devices. The more laser diodes the device has, the more noticeable hair growth will be in a shorter amount of time.

Money back guarantee and warranties are also another key factor when looking to purchase a laser device for hair growth. Do your due diligence before purchasing, and make sure you are fully covered in case you do not see success, or you experience a malfunction.

Now let’s begin to look at how Kiierr stacks up in the laser hair growth device industry.

Kiierr Laser Caps 

Kiierr laser caps are an FDA-cleared medical device designed for men and women suffering from hair loss ages 18 and older. These devices are equipped with medical grade laser diodes that emit low level light therapy on the scalp tissue to stimulate blood flow and growth in the hair follicles. They are also responsible for keeping existing hair strong and healthy.

You have three different options when it comes to purchasing a Kiierr laser cap. You can either choose from the Kiierr148Pro, Kiierr272Premier, or Kiierr272Premier-MD. These caps are made with 148 medical grade laser diodes (148Pro) and 272 medical grade laser diodes (272Premier and 272Premier-MD).

The caps are worn every other day for 30-minutes and treatment can be done whenever and wherever is convenient for you. There is an automatic timer placed in the caps, so your treatment time is automatically calculated for you and will turn off at the end of the 30-minutes. Customers typically report noticeable hair growth within the 4-7-month mark of religious treatment.

Read more: A Complete Guide to Kiierr’s Laser Cap

Kiierr Laser Cap vs Laser Combs

Kiierr laser caps and laser combs are quite different depending on which laser comb you purchase. However, both are FDA-cleared devices and can contain medical grade laser diodes that emit the low level light therapy treatment.

These two companies differ largely in price and how the treatment is completed. Laser caps are an intended treatment therapy that require no effort once you place the cap on your head. You simply turn them on and then back off once treatment is completed. The treatment requires no physical effort.

On the other hand, laser combs require more effort. You must physically comb through your hair with the device in order to hit all areas of the scalp that you want to be stimulated by the low level light therapy.

Also keep in mind that laser caps provide full scalp coverage. It is easy to miss some spots during treatment with the laser comb if you are not consistent. Overall, the Kiierr laser cap for hair loss is more convenient to use.

Read more: Kiierr Laser Cap vs Laser Comb Reviews

Kiierr vs HairClub for Men

Although both hair regrowth companies offer an array of benefits, you need to choose the one that fits your hair loss needs. There is no denying that HairClub redefines the haircare landscape by offering cutting-edge hair treatments such transplants and extensions.

But when it comes down to cost, commitment, and efficiency, Kiierr makes the better choice. Kiierr specializes in laser therapy and offers the safest hair regrowth treatment. Many scientific studies demonstrate how this technology makes your hair healthier and thicker. With its time-efficient home use caps, the procedure has become affordable for many. Kiierr even offers a payment plan that you can choose when purchasing your laser cap.

HairClub offers laser therapy treatment trough several different devices. They are not HairClub’s own laser therapy treatment devices, rather they sell other company’s products to their customers. They offer a laser comb, and two different brands of laser caps.

Read more: HairClub vs Kiierr

Kiierr vs Irestore

Kiierr’s hair growth caps are seen as a far more superior system, because not only does it use 148 lasers in one cap and 272 lasers in the other, but pricing is similar, starting out at $695 and ending at $1,295. This of course depends on what system you choose to get. As you can imagine, results will be effective much quicker when using the 272 laser diode cap versus the 148 laser diode cap. Kiierr uses only premium medical grade laser diodes in their caps, using not one LED light throughout their entire cap.

Kiierr also has a seven-month money back growth guarantee. This money back guarantee states that the customer is eligible for their full money back if they do not see new hair regrowth in the problematic areas. The customer must use the cap for a minimum of 7-months. You will also receive a two-year product warranty, where if any issues arise, we will send a new unit absolutely free.

iRestore has two laser caps on the market as of today. One cap consists of 51 lasers and LEDs while the other consists of 282 lasers and LEDs. Their Essential cap uses 51 medical-grade lasers and LEDs inside their helmet, consisting of 21 medical-grade lasers, and 30 medical-grade LEDs. We are unaware of how the medical grade lasers and LEDs are split within this new cap.

iRestore offers a 12-month money back guarantee on their products and a product warranty. Their free shipping is also a nice perk if you order their products.

Read more: Kiierr vs iRestore

Kiierr vs HairMax

Kiierr and Hairmax are similar in the fact that they both use medical grade laser diodes in their products. Neither use LEDs, which you may know are less effective than medical grade laser diodes. Both companies also offer a free 2-year warranty and free shipping within the United States.

The main differences between the two companies is the money back guarantee policy and the design of the products. Kiierr offers a 7-month growth guarantee and Hairmax offers 6. Kiierr’s laser caps also contain more laser diodes, which means you can see hair growth faster in a shorter amount of time.

If you are strictly looking to compare laser caps, Hairmax does offer one. It contains the same amount of laser diodes as Kiierr (272) but the price range is much more. The Kiierr272Premier laser cap can be purchased for $845, where the Hairmax Laser 272 PowerFlex Cap is sold for $1,899.

Read more: Kiierr vs HairMax Reviews

Kiierr vs Grivamax

Kiierr and Grivamax are identical in laser diodes which is beneficial for both products. The prices between the two caps are fairly similar as well.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees and warranty. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Grivamax gives a 6-month guarantee.

Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase. Grivamax on the other hand has a one-year warranty.

Read more: Kiierr vs Grivamax Laser Cap Review

Kiierr vs Theradome Laser Helmet

Kiierr and Theradome are similar in the fact that they both use laser diodes in their FDA-cleared medical devices.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees, warranty, and laser diode count. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Theradome offers a 180-day money back guarantee.

Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase. Theradome only offers a one-year limited warranty on their products.

As far as laser diodes, Kiierr laser hair growth caps contain 272. Theradome on the other hand only makes a helmet that contains 80 laser diodes. Keep in mind that the more laser diodes a device contains, the more effective they are in regrowing hair thicker and fuller.

Read more: Kiierr vs Theradome Laser Helmet Review

Kiierr vs Revian Red Hair Growth System

Both Kiierr and Revian offer free shipping on all purchases.

Kiierr contains strictly medical grade laser diodes while Revian contains only LEDs in their caps.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Revian gives a 6 month guarantee.

Read more: Kiierr vs Revian Red Hair Growth System Review

Kiierr vs iGrow

When comparing Kiierr laser cap and the iGrow laser helmet, there are a few things to keep in mind. Two things to be aware of are pricing and number of lasers/LEDs. Although iGrow is cheaper than Kiierr, it also only has a total of 51 medical-grade lasers, consisting of 21 lasers and 30 LEDs.

However, Kiierr has a total of 148 or 272 medical grade lasers depending on which unit you choose. Kiierr uses only premium laser diodes, using not one LED light throughout their entire cap, making it far more superior than its counterpart, getting the job done efficiently and effectively.

Read more: Kiierr vs iGrow Helmet

Kiierr vs Bosley Laser Caps

Bosley’s and Kiierr’s products aim to address your hair loss problems. However, Kiierr made it so convenient for just about anyone to enjoy the maximum benefits of the LLLT technology.

The main difference is between the price of the laser cap devices that both Kiierr and Bosley sell to their customers. Bosley products are significantly more expensive than Kiierr’s, especially for laser caps that contain the same number of laser diodes. For instance, Kiierr’s 272Premier laser cap costs $845 where the Bosley Revitalizer 272 costs $2,079.

Read more: Kiierr vs Bosley Hair Products

Kiierr vs illumiflow Laser Caps

Kiierr and illumiflow are similar in laser diodes which is beneficial for both products.

A big difference between the two hair growth caps will be found in their guarantees and warranty. Kiierr offers a 7 month guarantee or your money back. Illumiflow gives a 6 month guarantee.

The warranties also differ between the two products. Kiierr gives a two-year warranty with each cap, allowing you to be confident and protected with your purchase.

Illumiflow on the other hand has a five-year warranty, and if any issues arise, send you a new one for the cost of shipping.

Read more: Kiierr vs Illumiflow Reviews

Conclusion: Laser Hair Growth Device Reviews

Laser devices for hair growth are one of the best hair growth treatment methods available for men and women suffering from hair loss. However, as you now know, there are many different devices on the market to choose from. It is critical that you do your research and are familiar with the company and the device you are going to purchase to help combat your hair loss condition.

We recommend Kiierr laser caps above all else to help you kiss your hair loss goodbye! With impeccable customer service, 272 medical grade laser diodes, full scalp coverage, and FDA-clearance, your hair will thank you!
